content.summary: Digital transformation consultancy Grid Dynamics (NASDAQ:GDYN) reported Q2 CY2025 results exceeding the market’s revenue expectations, with sales up 21.7% year on year to $101.1 million. Revenue guidance for the full year exceeded analysts’ estimates, but next quarter’s guidance of $104 million was less impressive, coming in 1.2% below expectations. Its non-GAAP profit of $0.10 per share was in line with analysts’ consensus estimates.
